title: A trust root's quorum is a majority, and what it tolerates is stated exactly
note: Phase E, AUD-018. Each mutation weakens the trust root of agent_substrate/witness.py: a quorum that is not a majority, half counted as a majority, or a fault budget one too generous. tests/test_witness_quorum.py holds each, with the split view a minority quorum allowed among honest witnesses, reproduced with real witnesses, and the budget docs/formal/WitnessQuorum.tla checks.

mutations.name: WQ1_minority_quorum
mutations.rationale: a quorum of half the witnesses or fewer is accepted, and two disjoint groups of honest witnesses can each witness one fork

mutations.name: WQ2_half_is_a_majority
mutations.rationale: exactly half the witnesses counts as a majority

mutations.name: WQ3_tolerates_one_more
mutations.rationale: the quorum is said to tolerate one faulty witness more than it does
